data.name: Daryl
data.gender_notes: Daryl is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Daryl is derived from the Old English name Daran, which means 'free man'. It was a common name among the Anglo-Saxons, and later became popular in England during the Middle Ages. Daryl is a strong, masculine name with a rich history and strong meaning. The name Daryl carries the meaning “Free man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Daryl usually hope their child will grow to embody free man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Daryl belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Free man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daryl total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.meaning: דריל משמעותו חוזק ואהבה מקורית מאת אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דריל הוא שם שמקורו אינו ברור, אך יש המשערים כי הוא קשור למילה העברית 'דרור' שפירושה חופש או שחרור. עם זאת, אין לו שורש עברי ישיר והוא אינו מופיע במקרא. השם דריל נמצא בשימוש בעיקר בתרבויות נוצריות והוא עשוי להיות קשור למושגים של כוח, אהבה וחסד אלוהי.

in_greek.name: Ντάρυλ
in_greek.meaning: Ντάρυλ σημαίνει δύναμη και αγάπη από τον Θεό
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Ντάρυλ δεν έχει άμεση προέλευση από την ελληνική γλώσσα ή τη Βίβλο, αλλά πιθανότατα συνδέεται με έννοιες δύναμης και θεϊκής αγάπης. Στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία, οι ονόματι Ντάρυλ μπορεί να εμπνεύστηκαν από τις αρετές της δύναμης και της αγάπης που αναφέρονται στα Ευαγγέλια και τις Επιστολές του Παύλου.

in_english.name: Daryl
in_english.meaning: Daryl means beloved, cherished one, or strong, manly
in_english.long_meaning: The name Daryl, of uncertain origin, is believed to have roots in various cultures. It may derive from the English surname 'Darrell,' which could be linked to the Old French 'd'Arel,' meaning 'from Arel.' In Christian contexts, Daryl symbolizes strength, masculinity, and divine love. Though not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name's associations with positive attributes make it a popular choice among Christian parents seeking a name that reflects faith and character.

data.cultural_impact: Daryl became popular in the English-speaking world through the use of the name in literature and media. One of the most famous Daryls in popular culture is Daryl Dixon from the AMC television series The Walking Dead. This character embodies the self-sufficient, resourceful, and independent spirit of the name, making it a favorite among modern audiences.
data.spiritual_significance: Daryl is a name with deep spiritual significance for Christians, as it is a reminder of the freedom that comes from God's mercy and grace. In the Bible, we read about how God sets the captives free and gives us the power to live a life of righteousness and purpose. The name Daryl can serve as a constant reminder of this liberating power and inspire us to live our lives in accordance with God's will.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Daryl, meaning "free from sorrow" in Old English, symbolizes the hope and promise of eternal joy and peace in the Christian faith. It is a name that encourages those who bear it to find solace in the love and grace of God during times of hardship and sorrow.
